article.title: Secuencia temporal flexible en portugués
article.part: Relativas, condicionales y discurso referido — Relativas, condicionais e discurso relatado
article.chapter: Discurso directo, indirecto y secuencia temporal — Discurso direto, indireto e sequência temporal

claims.summary: The temporal sequence in Portuguese indirect discourse is relatively flexible, and the verb in the introductory clause in past does not always require transferring all subordinate verbs to the past tense.
The present tense can be used in indirect discourse when the content is presented as current or generic, while the imperfect tense situates the situation in the past.

claims.sectionKey: Para un futuro visto desde el pasado
claims.summary: The future of the preterite is frequent when expressing a future seen from the past.
